acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: We get a tip that an entire town is consumed by a huge, elementary-school-style crush on a local veterinarian. Guest host Lilly Sullivan goes to Utah to investigate the mystery of the hot vet.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: We do the thing the people in town would rather die than do – spill the crush to the legendary Dr. Artz himself. Lilly Sullivan reports.
acts.title: So…I Hear You’re Hot

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Producer Alix Spiegel talks to one of her closest friends, Sarah Blust, about the time Sarah met a stranger who, unbeknownst to her, had already spent years thinking about her.
acts.credits: By Alix Spiegel, Courtesey Alix Spiegel
acts.title: Who Is Sarah Blust?

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: There are certain jobs where thinking about someone else’s life is just built into it. Aviva DeKornfeld has a theory that petsitting is a job like that. She talks to a couple of pet sitters to find out.
acts.title: If These Dogs Could Talk
